messages:
Rae (CS): Heads-up: Aurora wants a short Brazil allowlist + burst window for a partner demo. Renewal touch in ~33 days. Can we pin to sa-east-1 and open 200.0.2.0/26 for 6h? Target QPS 300, burst 600. Customer AU-5510.

Tom (Acct Exec): They noted variable NATs. If we can show regional stability it helps renewal. I'll be on the demo.

Sam (SRE): Need exact CIDRs and token header. We can do region pin + ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke. Canary 10m before rollout?

Rae (CS): CIDR 200.0.2.0/26. Token header X-AU-Demo. Window 2026-06-10T18:00:00Z -> 2026-06-10T24:00:00Z (6h). QPS 300, burst 600.

Ivy (Solutions): Recommend KV warmup 1h prior and a 15m ramp. I'll upload harness. Also ask for p95 and error tracking.

Sam (SRE): Draft config: ```json
{
  "customer_id":"AU-5510",
  "region_pin":"sa-east-1",
  "allowlist":["200.0.2.0/26"],
  "rate_limits":{"qps":300,"burst":600},
  "start":"2026-06-10T18:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-06-11T00:00:00Z",
  "canary":{"duration":"10m","rollback_p95_ms":250,"rollback_error_pct":1},
  "notes":"6h Brazil demo; auto-revoke; warmup planned"
}
```

infra-bot: Ticket CS-7511 created. Canary scheduled at 6188888898. Requestor: Sam.

Sam (SRE): Canary checks passing (p95 95ms, errors 0.1%). Rolling full at 6188888920.

Rae (CS): Thanks team. I'll notify Aurora and add renewal follow-up. Ivy  please share harness link. Tom  prep renewal note tying success metrics to offer.

Ivy (Solutions): Warmup harness uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/AU-5510. Will run 1h before demo.

Rae (CS): Loop closed. Auto-revoke after window.
